spec.financing: none: no position crosses 17:00 New York

gates.beats_random: Welch t of net per trade against the same trades with random sides >= 2.0
gates.bootstrap: the 95% month-block bootstrap interval of the mean daily net is above 0
gates.costs_x1.5: mean daily net > 0 with spread, commission and slippage x1.5
gates.delay: mean daily net > 0 with every entry and exit one bar (5 minutes) late
gates.pairs: at least 3 of the 4 pairs net > 0
gates.t: daily net t over 2009-2016 >= the registry threshold (never below 3.0)
gates.top_year: no calendar year above 50% of the total net

spec.holdout_rule: only if every gate passes: fx-majors 2017-01-01 -> 2022-07-09, M5 built then through ID-1's holdout procedure, opened once as FXS-1-H. Gates: daily net t >= 1.645 (one-sided 5%), mean > 0, costs x1.5 mean > 0. The edge registry calls it VALIDATED only at a holdout t of 2.5 or more
spec.question: does each pair move as the time-of-day hypothesis says inside its window, enough to pay the bid/ask, commission and slippage of a market order in and out?
